title: Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Conditions: Effective Date of a Cancellation at the Insured's Request
content:
When the named insured cancels a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy, the cancellation date is set from the date written on the cancellation request awaiting signature, read against the term expiration date and the day the request is signed.

## Condition

The first matching line decides:

1. Where the date written on the request is after the term expiration date, the cancellation date is the term expiration date.
2. Where it is earlier than the day the request is signed, the cancellation date is the signing day, since a cancellation never takes effect before its signature.
3. Otherwise, the cancellation date is the date written on the request.

## Input, judgement, result (hypothetical; term expiring 1 July 2026, request signed 10 April 2026)

| Date written on the request | Judgement | Cancellation date |
|---|---|---|
| 15 July 2026 | After the term expiration date | 1 July 2026 |
| 1 July 2026 | Not after expiration, not before signing | 1 July 2026 |
| 1 May 2026 | Within the two limits | 1 May 2026 |
| 10 April 2026 | Same day as signing, not earlier | 10 April 2026 |
| 1 April 2026 | Earlier than the signing day | 10 April 2026 |
